title: Governance Contract Foundation
objective: Freeze the accepted v58 documentary baseline, normative governance rules, slice contracts, and handoffs before runtime implementation.
description: Mandatory slice-00 foundation that reconciles RQ-001 through RQ-009 and approved review findings into one executable, validated, and non-runtime spec package.
parallel_safe_reason: The documentary baseline must be frozen and closed before any implementation slice can begin.
must: Keep RQ-001 through RQ-009 and limited RQ-029 and RQ-100 dependencies traceable to AC-01 through AC-16.
Keep REV-01 through REV-16 materially covered by normative rules, acceptance criteria, slice scope, and validation.
Define one mutable condition authority and keep all manifests, briefs, matrices, PR content, exports, and gates as verified projections.
Define an executable default-deny authorization oracle without inventing implicit roles.
Define deterministic finding reconciliation, review event classification, condition eligibility, migration, and rollback behavior.
Validate all seven slice contracts, dependencies, allowed paths, execution briefs, and closure templates.
Keep every closure and evidence report in preimplementation state.
Make no runtime source, test, release, or deployment change.
not_included: Closing any acceptance criterion as passed.
acceptance: SPEC.md contains the authorized reconstructed acceptance baseline and normative rules needed to implement it without policy improvisation.
EXECUTION_PLAN.md and the seven slice contracts have explicit order, dependencies, write scopes, validation, and out-of-scope boundaries.
Every slice contains schema-valid slice.json plus preimplementation EXECUTION_BRIEF.md, CLOSURE_BRIEF.md, and pr.md.
The package identifies the canonical run store as the only mutable condition authority.
No expected read path points to known-missing repository documentation.
Schema, strict spec, handoff, local slice, Markdown, and diff checks pass.
No runtime or test file is modified by this slice.
